steps.note: Open the prepared upcoming RFQ's summary page.
Enable the required eRFX project setting before accessing the prepared RFQ.
Verify Order Activity is present and clickable in the RFQ Settings menu.
Click Order Activity to open its activity window.
Confirm the Order Activity window opened.
Cancel the activity window without confirming any change.
Verify the activity window closed after cancellation.
